Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas demo recording + slides — quick 15-min Q&A?

Hi Jordan,

Great to meet you earlier — thanks for taking the time to walk through Atlas's ingest and ML use cases. As promised, attached are: 1) the demo recording, and 2) the slide deck that covers our recommended deployment patterns and estimated unit costs for your ingestion profile.

Quick recap from our call:
- Primary goal: reduce per-inference latency for customer-facing recommendations and cut inference cost by ~30% vs current setup.
- Key constraints: data residency for EU PII, need for predictable monthly spend, and pilot window before Q4.
- Next steps we discussed: internal security questionnaire, pilot scope (10k monthly active users), and an integration sync for your infra team.

Attachments: atlas-demo-recording-20260715.mp4, atlas-demo-slides-20260715.pdf

If it helps, I can do a short 15-minute Q&A to walk through the slides and answer any integration questions for your infra team. Here are a few 15-min slots I have next week: Thu 7/22 10:30am PT, Thu 7/22 2:00pm PT — or grab a time that works for you here: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/15min

Would love to lock a quick slot so we can unblock the pilot timeline.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
